answer: Identity = hash(pubkey || burn_tx) where burn_tx destroys 5000 POA. Each epoch, identities must burn additional 200 to stay active. Attacker creating N identities burns N × 5000 upfront + N × 200 per epoch, cost compounding. System verifies via burn transaction receipts on Base; duplicate detection via nullifier set. Voting power = log(1 + total_burned). Threshold 75 POA burned for eligibility. Words: river, ledge, meadow.
